body:
**Adversarial review, round 1** on `0e7eb0a` by claude-opus-5-5 (builder: claude-sonnet-5-5).

No blocking findings. I checked the cases against the current code and they do real work: `/latest` currently returns 200 for `__proto__`, `constructor` and `toString`, because `readings[id]` finds Object.prototype, a function, or a truthy value. `/history` isn't served yet, so it answers 404 `not_found`, which doesn't match. So all FR-007 tests fail before the fix. FR-007 agrees with app/openapi.yaml: 404 with the Error schema is documented on both `/latest` and `/history`. It doesn't contradict the r1 requirements. The 5-hour range in the history test stays inside the 7-day limit, so the out-of-scope error-precedence question doesn't come up. One low-severity gap: the case's ID list is incomplete, so a hardcoded denylist would pass. Mergeable once that's fixed, or with the gap accepted.

- **F-1** [low] FR-007 covers an open-ended set of IDs, but the case only tests 5 of them — `app/cases/1/prototype-ids.spec.ts:3`
  FR-007 covers any "name of a JavaScript object prototype member (for example …)". The case only checks `__proto__`, `constructor`, `toString`, `hasOwnProperty` and `valueOf`. A denylist of exactly those five strings would pass every case, yet `isPrototypeOf`, `propertyIsEnumerable`, `toLocaleString`, `__defineGetter__` and `__lookupGetter__` would still hit Object.prototype through `readings[id]` in app/src/server.ts:13 and return 200 or crash. That breaks FR-007 and nothing would catch it. Fix: add the rest of the `Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Object.prototype)` names to the `ids` array, or build the array from that call. The aim is that only an own-property lookup (Object.hasOwn or a Map) passes. Optionally, also make FR-007 say exactly which names it means ("own properties of Object.prototype") instead of "for example".


Only @dharishan04 can close a finding without a fix: `/dismiss <F-n> <reason>`.
